covers: One (1) launch of the AutoInitializer Phase-A RECOVERY CONTINUATION, attempt 4, on a single NVIDIA L40S at no more than $0.99/h. It imports the verified Attempt-12 Stage-1 result -- the five preserved selected leaves, in the committed selected order, re-identified from the bytes that actually arrive on the pod -- and runs recovery Stages 2 through 5 under the frozen science, the existing watchdog, soft-stop, hard-stop, artifact-gate and provider-confirmed teardown behaviour. The beam search is not run, not reconstructed, and is structurally unreachable from this harness.

does_not_authorize: A beam search, a fresh Stage 1, or any reconstruction of the search - the continuation imports Attempt 12's result and cannot reach a search. Re-ranking or re-selecting the five leaves, or changing their committed selected order. Any science-plan modification. Retraining the permanent controls. Measuring the canonical control more than once, or on anything other than the frozen Stage-1 suite. Any new canary, rehearsal, readiness, measurement, architecture, pricing or harness expansion. Any additional storage cleanup, including deleting any of the 32 sole-copy remote objects totalling 69.671 GiB or the two protected wheelhouses. Any live-pod repair followed by a relaunch: a failed authorization, transport, staging, imported-leaf, control-measurement, admission, device-handoff, recovery, artifact-integrity, budget or provider gate is a fail-closed stop for review. Increasing the cumulative cap. Any follow-on or automatically started session. Reopening the frozen science: science plan 02be33b9, session plan 9377a2dc, Stage-3 protocol 250f72ef, equivalence interval 0.011695296982299022, feasibility floor 0.3, tokenizer 7781771acc3798ee, recovery fingerprint ab0d8cfd, the seed and conditional-sc policy, the operator ids and declared mathematics, or the recovery, search and selection rules. fail_closed_instruction: On any new material failure: preserve the full traceback and the stage artifacts, fail closed, collect evidence through the supported path, obtain provider-confirmed teardown, and return for review. Do not repair around a failed gate on the live pod and do not relaunch. Do not modify the provider-resilience, transport or portability machinery while the run is live. A transient control-plane observation may consume polling time under the existing deadline; it must never be interpreted as negative provider state. The five imported Stage-1 leaves are session INPUTS: they are not re-derived, not modified, and their canonical off-pod copies in the dev-box checkpoint store remain the durable record regardless of what happens in Stages 2-5. The transport repository is a delivery path and is not a scientific owner.
on_completion: Report rung-1 results, rung-2 results, whether the conditional seed-sc rung fired, the final selection, retained artifacts, actual spend and provider-confirmed teardown, together with commits and hashes, authorization identity, bundle round-trip and pod lifecycle. Tear the pod down as soon as the run reaches a terminal state rather than waiting for a backstop, and confirm teardown with the provider. Then STOP. Do not self-authorize any subsequent session.
